integrity: Infinite steps are justified by algebraic identities and the classical prime number theorem for progressions, not by bounded computation. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is parity-only and has a leading, not effective, density asymptotic. Established arithmetic coefficient identity and dyadic recurrence are attributed; unindexed equivalent literature may exist.
title: Prime-square parity fibers and asymptotic sparsity of the two-block odd partition function
